subject: Next steps: Hosted trial qualification for CortexPay
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@cortexpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted trial: quick follow-up and info we need

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciated the deep dive on the payment flow and the fraud-detection prompt set. Quick recap and the items we need to scope a Hosted trial: 

1) Workload profile (helpful to size endpoints):
   - Expected peak concurrent users: 120–200
   - Typical request size: ~150 tokens in, ~60 tokens out
   - Burst events (monthly): a couple of 10–15 minute spikes during batch processing windows

2) Security/compliance flags:
   - You mentioned auth via SSO and some PII in payloads. For the Hosted trial we can enable request-level redaction and token scrubbing. Will you confirm whether PCI data goes through the model?

3) Quickstart plan (what we'll provision for the pilot):
   - Sandbox endpoints (hosted) mapped to 2 logical routes (inference/chat and rerank)
   - Rate limit baseline we recommend: 20 requests/s per route with automatic bursting up to 50 for short windows (can be tuned)
   - Prefetch/KV caching enabled for common prefixes to reduce token spend

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm the two items above (peak/user and PCI in payloads)
- We provision sandbox keys and a staging endpoint (valid for 30 days)
- Short tech-onboard with our solutions engineer next week (30–45m) to map endpoints and test sample traffic

Attached is a one-page quickstart checklist that shows the exact artifacts we'll provide (sandbox keys, sample curl commands, expected ratecaps). If this aligns, I can provision sandbox access tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_quickstart_checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@cortexpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cortexpay.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted trial: quick follow-up and info we need

Rishi —

Thanks, that checklist is helpful. Quick answers from our side:

- Peak concurrent: closer to 180 on weekday peaks; average active sessions ~35–40.
- Request sizes: some requests spike to ~400 tokens when customers paste long dispute descriptions, but 90% are under 200 tokens.
- PCI: We do not want raw card data to traverse the model. We do send transaction metadata and masked card identifiers (last4). We also will need to validate that logs are redacted for merchant-sensitive fields.

We are open to doing the initial pilot on Hosted if the contract allows us to opt into a Dedicated or Private deployment later (we expect to evaluate that for 2029). Can you confirm migration path and whether model pinning/versioning is supported across modes?

Also attaching a short security questionnaire from our InfoSec team — some of those will be basic checks (SOC2, TLS, key management).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Byrne
Head of Integrations, CortexPay
Attachments: cortexpay_security_questions.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@cortexpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted trial: quick follow-up and info we need

Alex —

Great — thanks for the details and the questionnaire. High level answers now, we'll have your InfoSec answers in a separate doc by EOD tomorrow: 

- PCI: Hosted endpoints can be configured to drop specific fields before logs are stored. We also offer an HSM-backed KMS option for key management for enterprise customers; for the pilot we can enable request scrubbing and short log retention.
- Migration across modes: yes — the platform supports the same API surface across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. Model pinning, rollout policies, and prompt configs persist so moving from Hosted->Dedicated is a staged change (code/config-only) and we provide a migration runbook for stateful KV caches.
- Rate guidance: given your token patterns, start with 20 r/s per route and allow burst to 60 r/s for short windows. If you hit sustained 60+, we recommend moving to a dedicated pool.

I will provision the sandbox credentials and post them in a secure stub file (attached) and create a HubSpot playbook with our mutual action plan. Can you confirm the onboarding window — are mornings PST preferable?

Cheers,
Rishi
Attachments: sandbox_credentials_stub.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@cortexpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@cortexpay.com
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted trial: quick follow-up and info we need

Alex —

Looping in to schedule the tech-onboard. We have an SRE/solutions slot open next Thursday (Dec 7) at 10:00am PST or Friday (Dec 8) at 9:00am PST. The agenda will be:

- Walkthrough: sandbox endpoints + sample calls (15m)
- Rate/traffic test plan (15m)
- Security checklist review (15m)
- Next actions & rollout criteria (5m)

Action items before the call:
- Alex: confirm PCI note (no raw PAN through model) and share any additional sample payloads (max 3)
- CortexPay procurement: confirm PO/contract timeline if pilot goes well
- Rishi & Marissa: provision sandbox keys and HubSpot playbook, share drive folder with short onboarding runbook

If either time works, reply with preferred slot and we'll send calendar invites and a short dial-in packet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
